# Plugins

Plugins are packaged features (agents, actions, workflows, commands) distributed as npm
packages. Agent Smith ships several official plugins — filesystem, shell, agents and search —
that provide ready-to-use capabilities.

This section covers the CLI commands to install, update and manage plugins.

## Install a plugin

Use the <kbd>plugin</kbd> command with the npm package name of the plugin:

```bash
lm plugin @agent-smith/feat-git
```

The command installs the package globally with `npm i -g`, registers it in
`~/.config/agent-smith/config.yml` and syncs the config into the database. To install a
specific version, append `@latest` (or any npm tag/version):

```bash
lm plugin @agent-smith/feat-shell@latest
```

Pass `--noUpdateConf` to skip the automatic config sync:

```bash
lm plugin @agent-smith/feat-search --noUpdateConf
```

## Install everything

The <kbd>init</kbd> command installs the default set of plugins (filesystem, shell, agents and
search) and then offers to clone and install the Vue 3 graphical user interface:

```bash
lm init
```

Installed plugins are added to the config file automatically. The GUI, when accepted, is cloned
from `https://github.com/lynxai-team/agent-smith-ui`, built and ready to run with
`npm run local` from the `agent-smith-ui` folder. A Llama.cpp local backend is configured by
default; edit `${confDir}/config.yml` to add or remove backends.

## Update plugins

The <kbd>updateplugins</kbd> command updates the installed plugins to their latest versions:

```bash
lm updateplugins
```

## Manual configuration

Plugins can also be declared manually in the config file:

```yml
plugins:
  - "@agent-smith/feat-git"
```

Then run `lm conf` to register them. See the <a href="javascript:openLink('/terminal_client/config')">Config</a>
section for details.
